text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: The car is clearly carried: it slews and slides leftward and enlarges toward the camera over 15.0 to 15.8 s, with foam and wake lines on the brown water and a soft shadow. This is the readable swept-away passage.
